assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology and incretin-based therapy link a basic hormone discovery to transformative treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity, with large, durable clinical impact and broad downstream effects on cardiovascular and renal outcomes.
assessment.attribution: Holst (GLP-1 physiology and secretion), Drucker (GLP-1 biology and intestinotropic/therapeutic concept) and Mojsov (peptide characterization and early identification of active forms) form a coherent trio; Knudsen's drug-development work is also important and is omitted only because of the three-laureate cap. Credit among Habener-linked and industry contributors is disputed, and I cannot verify the details.
assessment.maturity: Very mature: multiple approved drugs, outcome trials and years of independent confirmation. Recognition is timely and arguably pressing.
uncertainties: Priority and credit for the early GLP-1 sequence and active-form work is contested.
Choice between basic-science and drug-development contributors is unresolved.
Long-term safety of chronic use is still accruing.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Genetically engineered T cells created a new class of living therapy, producing durable remissions in refractory B-cell malignancies. The concept is original and the clinical effect is unambiguous.
assessment.attribution: Sadelain (chimeric receptor design with costimulation), June (clinical translation in CLL and ALL) and Rosenberg (adoptive cell therapy and early gene-engineered T cells) are plausible. Other pioneers, such as Eshhar, are not in the credited names, so the allocation is uncertain.
assessment.maturity: Several approved products and over a decade of follow-up. Limitations in solid tumors and toxicity remain, but the core discovery is secure.
uncertainties: Whether the prize centers on the receptor design or on the clinical translation is unclear.
Credit among early chimeric-receptor inventors is complex.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Splice-modulating antisense therapy for spinal muscular atrophy turned a fatal childhood disease into a treatable one and established a general principle for RNA-targeted drugs.
assessment.attribution: Krainer (mechanistic splicing work identifying the SMN2 target) and Bennett (antisense chemistry and drug development) are a clean, well-matched pair. Both are credited with decisive and complementary roles.
assessment.maturity: Approved therapy for several years with strong long-term clinical data, though the timescale of follow-up is still modest.
uncertainties: Contributions of other antisense chemistry and clinical-development groups may deserve credit.
Long-term durability in treated patients is still emerging.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The unfolded protein response revealed an intracellular signaling pathway from the ER to the nucleus and underlies proteostasis in physiology and disease. It is a conceptually original and widely applied discovery.
assessment.attribution: Walter and Mori delineated the IRE1-HAC1/XBP1 pathway independently and converged on the mechanism, so the pair is a natural configuration. Other contributors (for example Kaufman, Ron) are not credited here.
assessment.maturity: Very mature with decades of confirmation across yeast and mammals. The disease and therapeutic relevance is still being established, which tempers the case.
uncertainties: Direct clinical translation is less developed than for other candidates.
Relative priority of Mori versus other UPR pioneers is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: cGAS-STING defined how cytosolic DNA is sensed by innate immunity and connects infection, autoimmunity, cancer immunity and senescence. The discovery is original and mechanistically clear.
assessment.attribution: Chen identified cGAS and the second messenger cGAMP, and Barber identified STING; together they cover the core. Others (Ishikawa, Sun, Wu) contributed to the pathway, which makes the allocation somewhat contested.
assessment.maturity: Strong independent confirmation, though therapeutic translation is still early and clinical impact is unproven.
uncertainties: Therapeutic impact is not yet established.
Credit allocation among STING and cGAS discoverers is debatable.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optogenetics transformed the experimental dissection of neural circuits and many other cell types, a major methodological and conceptual advance with broad reach across biology.
assessment.attribution: Channelrhodopsin discovery (Nagel, Hegemann, with Bamberg) and neuronal deployment (Deisseroth, Boyden) are both decisive. Six credited names cannot be fit into three, so the allocation is the hardest part. Miesenböck's earlier genetically targeted approach complicates it.
assessment.maturity: Mature as a research tool with thousands of applications; clinical use is only beginning, such as in vision restoration.
uncertainties: Three-person limit cannot honor all decisive contributors.
Value as a tool rather than as a therapy may weigh differently for the committee.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Adult stem-cell-derived organoids opened a platform for studying tissue renewal, disease modelling and personalized therapy testing, building on Lgr5 stem-cell identification.
assessment.attribution: Clevers is the clear intellectual driver, with Sato as the first author of the key intestinal organoid work. The pair is plausible, and the credited list supports it.
assessment.maturity: Widely replicated and used, with a growing but still limited clinical translation.
uncertainties: Whether the prize would instead focus on Lgr5 stem cells is unclear.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The discovery of cell-free fetal DNA in maternal plasma created noninvasive prenatal testing, which has since changed routine prenatal care worldwide and spawned the liquid-biopsy field.
assessment.attribution: Lo is credited as the sole discoverer and developer, giving a clean and unambiguous attribution, though a one-person prize is uncommon.
assessment.maturity: Mature: introduced clinically in 2011 and adopted globally with extensive validation. Timing is appropriate.
uncertainties: Evidence for contributions from other groups in the supplied credit is limited.
The conceptual novelty relative to the technical translation may be debated.
